note: The AMM routers the SwapExecutor on Robinhood Chain mainnet may call, and how: 1 is v3-periphery's SwapRouter shape (deadline in the params), 2 is SwapRouter02's. PancakeSwap Infinity's and Uniswap v4's Universal Routers are reached through the platform's UniversalRouterAdapter in front of each (KeyedPoolAdapters, chain-4663-keyed-adapters), which the executor calls as a v3-periphery router, so they are named by their Ignition record and listed once it exists. Each is the address the AMM itself publishes, the same as apps/web/src/constants/swapProviders.ts; scripts/executor-venues.ts checks each on chain before listing it. The platform's own routers are listed too: the first at deployment (base.json platformRouter), the constant-product launchpad's (28 September 2026) here.
